source_en: What's with you? Ran away from your master Linne and became a⏎stray again, huh? I thought dogs like you were supposed to be loyal.⏎Glad you're having a good time off your leash, I guess...

source_en: Waldstein
source_slot: Waldstein

source_en: A good time, you say...? I can use my power without restraint, without⏎a thought of the final Night or anything beyond... I can fight as I've⏎always wanted to fight. Yes, I would call that a good time.
source_slot: Divertirmi, dici? Posso usare il mio potere senza trattenermi,⏎senza pensare all'ultima Notte o a ciò che verrà dopo... Posso⏎combattere come ho sempre voluto. Sì, direi che mi diverto.

source_en: Hyde
source_slot: Hyde

source_en: You know what, old-timer? You've been around dozens of times⏎longer than I have. A kid like me has no place tellin' you what⏎to do with your life. Do whatever you want, as far as I care.
source_slot: La sai una cosa, vecchio? Hai vissuto decine di volte i miei anni.⏎Non è compito di un ragazzino come me dirti cosa fare⏎della tua vita. Per quanto m'importa, fai quel che ti pare.

source_en: But I gotta say, annoying as your whole "warrior" shtick was at times,⏎I'd like to think I had a certain level of respect for you. Now you're⏎putting that "warrior" name to shame. You sure we can't talk?
source_slot: Ma devo dire che, per quanto fosse seccante, avevo un certo⏎rispetto per tutta quella tua filosofia da "guerriero". Ora invece⏎l'hai gettata nel fango. Sei sicuro che non possiamo parlarne?

source_en: Hmm... "Warrior," yes... That takes me back.⏎There was once a time when I, too, was young⏎and overflowing with such ideals as those...
